name: Carnal Contract
source:
You play as a young guy who finds himself burdened with a staggering amount of debt after losing his father in a weird accident.

Just when things seem bleak, a peculiar game emerges, promising substantial monetary rewards for completing seemingly insignificant challenges.

However, our protagonist soon discovers that the true cost goes far beyond mere money. Each task poses a threat to his most cherished relationships, testing the bonds with those closest to him.

Navigate his life and complete challenges, all while living in a house with three gorgeous women.

Who is behind the game? What will it make him do? Can he get out?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/DottyDiaries/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个年轻人，在一场奇怪的事故中失去了父亲后，发现自己背负着巨额债务。

正当事情看起来黯淡时，一款奇特的游戏出现了，承诺完成看似微不足道的挑战将获得丰厚的金钱奖励。

然而，我们的主角很快发现真正的成本远远超出了金钱的范围。每项任务都对他最珍视的关系构成威胁，考验着他与最亲近的人的关系。

驾驭他的生活并完成挑战，同时与三个美丽的女人住在一所房子里。

谁是游戏的幕后黑手？这会让他做什么？他能出去吗？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/DottyDiaries/about]Patreon[/url]]
